newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy Oct PSBR to fall but top 1996 goal.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy Oct PSBR to fall but top 1996 goal.

text.p: Italy's October public sector borrowing requirement (PSBR) is expected to be less than year ago levels, but the government's revised target of 123 trillion lire for 1996 is likely to be overshot, a Reuter poll showed.
On average, analysts predicted October's deficit below a year ago's 24 trillion lire. Forecasts ranged from 16 trillion from the Banca di Roma to 23.5 trillion seen by Credito Italiano.
For all of 1996, only Credito Italiano saw PSBR coming on target at 123 trillion lire. The government recently revised up its 1996 ceiling to 123 trillion from 113 trillion.
Banca di Roma saw a 1996 deficit of 130 trillion lire, Caboto brokers saw 128 trillion and Banca di Roma 130 trillion.
The size of the yearend overshoot would be determined by the effect of the government's 16 trillion lire June mini-budget, analysts said.
"I expect a limited effect of 11-12 trillion lire rather than the expected 16 trillion," said Andrea Marchetti, analyst at Credito Italiano.
"Any further overshoot of the 123 trillion lire ceiling would mean that there has been no structural improvement in the state balance sheet," said Chiara Manenti, a Caboto analyst.

"The last quarter should see an impact of the mini-budget of (Prime Minister Romano) Prodi," said Marcello Esposito of Banca Commerciale Italiana (BCI), adding there was a "risk that some of the measures will give results much below expectations."

For October, Giuliano Gasparini of Prometeia research institute saw a positive effect, worth between 3 to 4 trillion lire, of the payment of pensions to be made on the first day of the following month.
Roberta Costantini of Banca di Roma justified his 16 trillion lire forecast for the month by noting lower debt financing costs of some three trillion lire over October 1995.

Forecasts on debt interest payments for the whole year varied widely, between 177.5 trillion lire seen by Credito Italiano to the 195 trillion forecast by BCI. In 1995, interest payment costs totalled 195.3 trillion lire.
